name: Molecular Orbitals
desc: A molecular electron-density plate: a ring of atoms carries phase-signed p and d orbital lobes that overlap into bright bonding density, the whole cluster tumbling on two incommensurate rotations while a delocalized electron sea fills the frame — warm and cool lobes marking the sign of the wavefunction.
